new_value: {"notes":"Fixed duplicate packet_info.payload_buf declaration on 2026-08-27. Git history shows the established merge intent is payload pointer, payload_len, then one MAX+1 owned buffer; removed the stale earlier MAX-only member. This retains space for adapter_parse.c's terminator write at payload_len==LICHEN_MESHTASTIC_TEXT_PAYLOAD_MAX and avoids ABI/order ambiguity. Added compile-time assertions for buffer extent/order, runtime callback assertion for max-payload termination, and an independent host/Zephyr layout fixture that compiles the public header without the full module Kconfig graph. Validation: strict C23 host UBSan CTest 1/1 PASS; standalone local Zephyr 4.1 32-bit qemu_x86 runtime 1/1 PASS; cppcheck and diff check PASS. The full meshtastic_adapter local 4.1 configuration remains blocked before compilation by the known NET_IPV6_ND/NET_RAW_MODE project Kconfig cycle, so the independent gate intentionally excludes LICHEN module Kconfig; the original duplicate-member compiler failure is directly covered."}
